title: Net Income
description: Operating profit after tax. Net income (or net profit) is calculated as the sum of project revenues minus the sum of project expenses.

components.content:
## Formula

**NP = Σ R - Σ E**

Where:
- **NP** = Net Profit (or Net Income)
- **R** = Project Revenues
- **E** = Project Expenses

## Expenses Include

All costs needed to generate revenue:
- Labor
- Material
- Services
- Inventory
- Supplies
- Depreciation
- Employee salaries
- Renting buildings
- Insurance coverage
- Income taxes
